programme.title: Johnny Yuma

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture

programme.desc: Watson (Nigel Bruce) brings in Holmes (Basil Rathbone) on a case of ritual murder at the old Musgrave estate.
programme.title: Sherlock Holmes Faces Death

programme.desc: A recluse mountain man becomes the unwilling object of a long vendetta by Indians, and proves to be a match for their warriors.
programme.title: Jeremiah Johnson

programme.desc: Superspy Derek Flint (James Coburn), agent of Z.O.W.I.E., stops a geothermal plot to control the world's weather.
programme.title: Our Man Flint

programme.desc: John Adams (William Daniels), Benjamin Franklin (Howard da Silva) and Thomas Jefferson (Ken Howard) lead the way to the Colonies' Declaration of Independence.
Two con men (Sidney Poitier, Bill Cosby) are persuaded by a retired policeman (James Earl Jones) to volunteer their services to a ghetto youth center.
programme.title: A Piece of the Action

programme.desc: Songwriter Jerome Kern (Robert Walker) recalls his career on the opening night of his Show Boat, December 1927.
programme.title: Till the Clouds Roll By

programme.desc: Dorothy tries to save her dog from a storm and eases on down the road to see the Wiz with Tin Man, Scarecrow and Cowardly Lion.
programme.title: The Wiz

programme.title: Superman III

programme.desc: An English girl's dream of racing her horse in the Grand National thunders to reality with the help of a former jockey.
programme.title: National Velvet

programme.desc: The first manned flight to Mars is a flop, so a space official (Hal Holbrook) fakes it Hollywood-style for the public.
programme.title: Capricorn One

programme.desc: Doc Holliday (Kirk Douglas) joins Wyatt Earp (Burt Lancaster) and his brothers for a Tombstone showdown with the Clanton gang.
programme.title: Gunfight at the O.K. Corral

programme.desc: A framed sheriff (John McIntire) is about to hang, but his bogus wayward daughters have a plan.
programme.title: The New Daughters of Joshua Cabe

programme.title: The Shootist
